translations.literal: Your subject holds the post of chief minister, assisting Heaven in governing things; if governance is not harmonious, it is your subject's fault.'
translations.idiomatic: I hold the post of chief minister, assisting Heaven in governing things. If governance is not harmonious, it is my fault.'

sentences.zh: 頓首請罪。

translations.literal: He kowtowed and begged punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He kowtowed and begged punishment.

sentences.zh: 後曰：「真宰相！」

translations.literal: ' The empress said: 'A true chief minister!'
translations.idiomatic: ' The empress said, 'A true chief minister!'

sentences.zh: 會李昭德下獄，景佺苦申救，後以為面欺，左遷秦州刺史。

translations.literal: When Li Zhaode was imprisoned Jingqian strenuously pleaded for him; the empress considered it face-deception and demoted him to prefect of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zhaode was imprisoned Jingqian strenuously pleaded for him. The empress considered it face-deception and demoted him to prefect of Qin.

sentences.zh: 入拜司刑卿。

translations.literal: He entered court as appointed director of the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as appointed director of the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 聖歷元年，復以鳳閣侍郎同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenglì he was again vice minister of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-director of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Shenglì era he was again vice minister of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-director of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，陷河北數州，虜已去，武懿宗欲盡論其罪，景佺以為脅從可原，後如其議。

translations.literal: The Khitan invaded and seized several Hebei prefectures; after the barbarians had gone Wu Yizong wished to punish all their crimes; Jingqian held that those coerced could be forgiven; the empress followed his view.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan invaded and seized several Hebei prefectures. After the barbarians had gone Wu Yizong wished to punish all their crimes. Jingqian held that those coerced could be forgiven, and the empress followed his view.

sentences.zh: 罷為秋官尚書。

translations.literal: He was dismissed as minister of the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed as minister of the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 坐漏省內語，降司刑少卿。

translations.literal: Punished for leaking inner-court speech, he was demoted to vice director of the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for leaking inner-court speech, he was demoted to vice director of the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 出為并州長史，道病卒，贈相州刺史。

translations.literal: He was sent out as chief administrator of Bing and died of illness on the road; posthumously made prefect of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as chief administrator of Bing and died of illness on the road. He was posthumously appointed prefect of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 初名元方，垂拱中改今名。

translations.literal: His original name was Yuanfang; in the Chuigong era it was changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Yuanfang. In the Chuigong era it was changed to the present name.

sentences.zh: 李懷遠，字廣德，邢州柏仁人。

translations.literal: Li Huaiyuan, courtesy name Guangde, was a native of Boren in Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaiyuan, styled Guangde, was a native of Boren in Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 少孤，嗜學。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, he loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he loved learning.

sentences.zh: 宗人欲藉以高蔭，懷遠辭，退而曰：「因人之勢，高士恥之。

translations.literal: Clansmen wished to use him for high yin privilege; Huaiyuan declined and on retiring said: 'Relying on another's power—a lofty gentleman is ashamed of it.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen wished to use him for high yin privilege. Huaiyuan declined and on retiring said, 'Relying on another's power—a lofty gentleman is ashamed of it.

sentences.zh: 假蔭而官，吾誌邪？」

translations.literal: Taking yin shade for office—is that my aim?'
translations.idiomatic: Taking yin shade for office—is that my aim?'

sentences.zh: 擢四科第，累轉司禮少卿，出為本州刺史，改冀州，遷揚、益二都督府長史，徙同州刺史。

translations.literal: He placed in four special examinations, was repeatedly transferred to vice minister of the Bureau of Rites, sent out as prefect of his native prefecture, changed to Jizhou, moved to chief administrator of Yang and Yi, and transferred to prefect of Tong.
translations.idiomatic: He placed in four special examinations, was repeatedly transferred to vice minister of the Bureau of Rites, sent out as prefect of his native prefecture, changed to Jizhou, moved to chief administrator of Yang and Yi, and transferred to prefect of Tong.

sentences.zh: 治尚清簡。

translations.literal: His governance valued purity and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: His governance valued purity and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 累遷鸞臺侍郎，進同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，封平鄉縣男。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Luan Terrace and advanced to co-director of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace, enfeoffed as Baron of Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Luan Terrace and advanced to co-director of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace, enfeoffed as Baron of Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍同中書門下三品，爵趙郡公，賜實封戶三百。

translations.literal: As left regular attendant he was third rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery, ennobled as Duke of Zhao, granted three hundred actual fief households.
translations.idiomatic: As left regular attendant he was third rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery, ennobled as Duke of Zhao, and granted three hundred actual fief households.

sentences.zh: 以老，聽致仕。

translations.literal: Citing old age, he was permitted to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Citing old age, he was permitted to retire.

sentences.zh: 中宗還京師，召知東都留守，復加同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong returned to the capital he was summoned to know the eastern capital defense and again added third rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong returned to the capital he was summoned to oversee the eastern capital defense and again added third rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 懷遠久貴，益素約，不治居室。

translations.literal: Huaiyuan had long been noble yet became ever more frugal, not maintaining his dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiyuan had long been noble yet became ever more frugal, not maintaining his dwelling.

sentences.zh: 嘗乘款段馬，僕射豆盧欽望謂曰：「公貴顯，顧當然邪？」

translations.literal: He once rode a plain pony; vice director Dou Lu Qinwang said to him: 'You are noble and eminent—should it be thus?'
translations.idiomatic: He once rode a plain pony. Vice director Dou Lu Qinwang said to him, 'You are noble and eminent—should it be thus?'

sentences.zh: 答曰：「吾幸其馴，不願它駿。」

translations.literal: He replied: 'I am fortunate it is tame; I do not wish for another steed.'
translations.idiomatic: He replied, 'I am fortunate it is tame. I do not wish for another steed.'

sentences.zh: 神龍二年卒，帝賜錦衾斂，自為文祭之，贈侍中，謚曰成。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Shenlong; the emperor granted brocade quilts for the encoffinment and himself composed a text to sacrifice him; posthumously made palace attendant, posthumous name Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Shenlong. The emperor granted brocade quilts for the encoffinment and himself composed a text to sacrifice him. He was posthumously appointed palace attendant, with the posthumous name Cheng (Accomplished).

sentences.zh: 子景伯，景龍中為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: His son Jingbo in the Jinglong era was remonstrance officer.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jingbo in the Jinglong era was remonstrance officer.

sentences.zh: 中宗宴侍臣及朝集使。

translations.literal: Zhongzong banqueted attendant ministers and the court assembly envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong banqueted attendant ministers and the court assembly envoys.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，各命為《回波詞》，或以諂言媚上，或要丐謬寵，至景伯，獨為箴規語以諷帝，帝不悅。

translations.literal: When the wine was deep each was ordered to compose a Hui Bo lyric; some flattered the sovereign with fawning words, some begged absurd favor—when it came to Jingbo he alone made admonitory words to remonstrate with the emperor; the emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine was deep each was ordered to compose a Hui Bo lyric. Some flattered the sovereign with fawning words, some begged absurd favor. When it came to Jingbo he alone made admonitory words to remonstrate with the emperor. The emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 中書令蕭至忠曰：「真諫官也。」

translations.literal: Chief minister Xiao Zhizhong said: 'A true remonstrance officer.
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Xiao Zhizhong said, 'A true remonstrance officer.

sentences.zh: 景雲中，進太子右庶子。

translations.literal: In the Jingyun era he was advanced to right guardian of the heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingyun era he was advanced to right guardian of the heir.

sentences.zh: 時有建言置都督府非是，詔群臣普議，景伯與太子舍人盧俌議：「今天下諸州分隸都督，專生殺刑賞。

translations.literal: At the time someone proposed that establishing military governorships was wrong; an edict ordered the ministers broadly to deliberate; Jingbo with the crown prince's aide Lu Fu deliberated: 'Today all prefectures under Heaven are subordinated to military governors who monopolize the power of life, death, punishment, and reward.
translations.idiomatic: At the time someone proposed that establishing military governorships was wrong. An edict ordered the ministers broadly to deliberate. Jingbo with the crown prince's aide Lu Fu deliberated, 'Today all prefectures under Heaven are subordinated to military governors who monopolize the power of life, death, punishment, and reward.

sentences.zh: 使授非其人，則權重釁生，非強幹弱枝、經邦軌物之誼。

translations.literal: If those appointed are not the right men, then heavy authority breeds disaster—this is not the meaning of strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches, governing the state and setting things on track.
translations.idiomatic: If those appointed are not the right men, then heavy authority breeds disaster—this is not the meaning of strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches, governing the state and setting things on track.

sentences.zh: 願罷都督，留御史，以時按察，秩卑任重，以制奸宄便。」

translations.literal: I wish military governorships abolished and censors retained to inspect in season—low rank but heavy responsibility—to control treachery conveniently.'
translations.idiomatic: I wish military governorships abolished and censors retained to inspect in season—low rank but heavy responsibility—to control treachery conveniently.'

sentences.zh: 繇是停都督。

translations.literal: Thereby military governorships were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby military governorships were stopped.

sentences.zh: 終右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He ended as right regular attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as right regular attendant.

sentences.zh: 子彭年，有才，剖析明悟。

translations.literal: His son Pengnian had talent, clear in analysis and understanding.
translations.idiomatic: His son Pengnian had talent, clear in analysis and understanding.

sentences.zh: 歷遷中書舍人、吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly transferred to Secretariat drafter and vice minister of the civil service.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly transferred to Secretariat drafter and vice minister of the civil service.

sentences.zh: 與李林甫善。

translations.literal: He was on good terms with Li Linfu.
translations.idiomatic: He was on good terms with Li Linfu.

sentences.zh: 常慕山東著姓，為婚姻，引就清列。

translations.literal: He always admired the great surnames east of the mountains, made marriages with them, and drew them into clear ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He always admired the great surnames east of the mountains, made marriages with them, and drew them into clear ranks.

sentences.zh: 典選七年，卒以贓敗，長流臨賀郡。

translations.literal: Holding selections seven years, he finally failed through bribery and was long exiled to Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: Holding selections seven years, he finally failed through bribery and was long exiled to Linhe.

sentences.zh: 天寶十二載，擢為濟陰太守，徙馮翊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Tianbao he was promoted to prefect of Jiyin and moved to Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Tianbao he was promoted to prefect of Jiyin and moved to Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 天子幸蜀，陷於賊，脅以偽官，憂憤死，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven visited Shu he fell into the rebels' hands; coerced into a false office he died of grief and indignation; posthumously made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven visited Shu he fell into the rebels' hands. Coerced into a false office, he died of grief and indignation. He was posthumously appointed minister of rites.
